gaps.term: Operator norm of a linear map
gaps.note: The page defines the norm ||u|| only for vectors, then uses ||I-N||, ||N^{-1}||, ||R||, ||Q||, ||C|| and ||E|| for linear maps and multiplies such bounds together. Operator norms are outside the reader profile, and the page neither explains nor links them.

The page states that the Neumann series converges to N^{-1} and then gives ||N^{-1}|| <= 2 with no argument. The reader cannot check it: that needs the norm estimate of the series (the sum of ||I-N||^m) and the submultiplicativity of the map norm, and neither is given.
